items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: They used a fellow they called Elmo. I never did know his other name, Elmo. He's an old time clarinet player.

ctx.x: And that was before World War II or after?

After, before. Before World War II. I see. I see. At various times, I saw a couple of times they used a clarinet when they called for it. They used a fellow they called Elmo. I never did know his other name, Elmo. He's an old time clarinet player.

Let's see now. Since you made those records for Russell, and I've known you, you said you were playing with Fairbank then. Who else did you play with in the meantime? You said you had your own band, huh? Yeah.
